intended_paths.status: staging-only handoff; no canonical path is claimed

implementation.argument_surface: receiver in ECX (aliased into EDI at 0x00641e12); no ordinary stack argument of the body's own. The only two pushes, 0x00641e2b and 0x00641e2f, are the argument pair of the direct callee and are dropped by ADD ESP,0x8 at 0x00641e35
implementation.receiver_model: opaque word-addressed block; every access is stated as a machine displacement and no member is named
implementation.dispatch_model: the pointee's dispatch word is read, the word at displacement 4 of that block is read as a slot, and control is transferred through it; the slot target itself is unresolved and is not named
implementation.compile_gate: clang++ -m32 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -c <file> -o /dev/null; the .cpp and the .hpp both compile clean

observed_original_abi.receiver_alias: EDI (MOV EDI,ECX at 0x00641e12; every receiver access in the body goes through that alias)
observed_original_abi.ghidra_convention_note: Live decompilation reports void __fastcall FUN_00641e10(int param_1) and the record carries ghidra_calling_convention_signal=no_information, ghidra_parameter_count=0, return_type=undefined. __thiscall is derived from the ECX receiver dereference at 0x00641e14, from the callee-never-written-through ECX, and from the bare RET at 0x00641e3a with caller-side stack cleanup.
observed_original_abi.dispatch: abi_derived.dispatch records indirect_calls=1 and call_offsets=[]; the listing's single indirect transfer is 0x00641e29 CALL EDX

mechanics.body_shape: prologue saves ESI/EDI, the receiver's word at displacement 0x20 is read, a non-null pointee is detached and dispatched through a slot, and one direct call closes the body

receiver_displacement.0x20: read at 0x00641e14 (MOV ECX,[EDI+0x20]), addressed again by LEA ESI,[EDI+0x20] at 0x00641e17, written at 0x00641e1e (MOV dword ptr [ESI],0x0), and passed by address to the direct callee at 0x00641e2b. This is the only displacement the machine-derived receiver record enumerates (receiver.offsets=[32], bounds_only=true), and the record names no member for it.

mechanics.base_adjustment: 0x00641e2c ADD EDI,0x4 forms the address receiver+4 and passes it to the direct callee. The body never dereferences through that address, so it is not a receiver field access; it is written in decimal in the model for that reason.

machine_literal_accounting.note: every 0x literal the 19-instruction listing carries, and what the instruction does with each. Listed so a reader can see that the one the receiver record does not enumerate is accounted for rather than dropped.
machine_literal_accounting.0x20: receiver word: read at 0x00641e14, addressed by LEA ESI at 0x00641e17, cleared at 0x00641e1e, passed by address at 0x00641e2b. The only displacement the machine-derived receiver record enumerates (receiver.offsets=[32]).
machine_literal_accounting.0x0: the value stored at 0x00641e1e (MOV dword ptr [ESI],0x0). Modelled as a stored null pointer; no machine record gives the word a type, so the zero is not claimed to be a null object pointer in the original.
machine_literal_accounting.0x4: read at 0x00641e26 as the slot's byte displacement inside the POINTEe's dispatch word. A different object from the receiver, so the receiver record has no standing over it; modelled as dword index 1, the same byte.
machine_literal_accounting.0x8: ADD ESP,0x8 at 0x00641e35, the caller-side cleanup of the direct callee's two-word argument pair. Encoded by declaring FUN_005bf0e0 __cdecl in the header rather than by an explicit stack adjustment in the body.
machine_literal_accounting.addresses: 0x00641e2b (JZ target) and 0x005bf0e0 (CALL target) are branch/transfer addresses, not data constants, and are reproduced as the control flow and the direct callee respectively.

mechanics.null_behavior: A zero word at 0x20 takes JZ 0x00641e2b: no clear, no slot read, no indirect transfer. The direct callee still runs, because its block is the shared tail.
mechanics.non_null_behavior: The word at 0x20 is cleared to zero BEFORE the dispatch word is read and before control leaves, so the receiver no longer references the pointee while the pointee's slot runs, and a re-entry into this body from that slot would take the null branch.

virtual_dispatch_site.shape: MOV EAX,[ECX] (0x00641e24) then MOV EDX,[EAX+0x4] (0x00641e26) then CALL EDX (0x00641e29)
virtual_dispatch_site.receiver_at_the_transfer: ECX, untouched since 0x00641e14, so the pointee arrives as the slot's receiver; nothing is pushed and this body does not adjust ESP afterwards
virtual_dispatch_site.slot_index_modelled: 1 (displacement 4 of the dispatch word read as the second dword)
virtual_dispatch_site.slot_target: UNRESOLVED. No record for this target names the table, the slot or the callee it resolves to, so none is named here.

direct_call.arguments: two pointers pushed right to left: receiver+4 first in the argument list, &receiver[0x20] second
direct_call.cleanup: ADD ESP,0x8 at 0x00641e35, so the callee is caller-cleaned (cdecl shape) and takes exactly two words
direct_call.callee_record: ghidra_get_function_by_address 0x005bf0e0 -> 'undefined FUN_005bf0e0(void)', body 0x005bf0e0..0x005bf11e; live decompilation 'undefined4 FUN_005bf0e0(undefined4 *, undefined4)' returns 1 or 0 and performs its own virtual transfer at slot displacement 0x2c on a service from FUN_0067de30

mechanics.return_semantics_machine: EAX at 0x00641e3a is the word the direct callee returned: 0x00641e30 is the last write to EAX in the body and the ADD ESP at 0x00641e35 does not touch it. The record classifies that word as unclassified_in_EAX (register_class aggregate_unknown, return.type null, void_possible false), so the model returns it under the record's own name and classifies it no further.
mechanics.globals: none: the complete 19-instruction listing names no data-segment address
mechanics.control_flow: one conditional branch, JZ 0x00641e2b at 0x00641e1c, whose target is inside the body span 0x00641e10..0x00641e3a

return_semantics.value: the return word of the direct callee 0x005bf0e0; the body classifies nothing about it
return_semantics.ownership: The body performs no reference acquisition on the path it takes through the slot and no release it can name: the slot's effect on the detached pointee is not established by any record for this target.
return_semantics.lifetime: The word at 0x20 is cleared before the transfer, so after this call the receiver holds no reference to the pointee; who holds one afterwards, and for how long, is not established by this body.

evidence.decompiler: void __fastcall FUN_00641e10(int param_1) { piVar1 = *(int **)(param_1 + 0x20); if (piVar1 != 0) { *(undefined4 *)(param_1 + 0x20) = 0; (**(code **)(*piVar1 + 4))(); } FUN_005bf0e0(param_1 + 4,(undefined4 *)(param_1 + 0x20)); return; }

evidence.vtable_note: These eight are a transitive classifier association on the record, not a vtable reference count, and this body is a dispatcher rather than a vtable member. They are recorded for the integrator and deliberately not used to name the table the slot read reaches.

provenance: tools/reconstruction_tooling/abi_infer.py record embedded in the pack (abi category)
unresolved_questions: What does the slot at displacement 4 of the pointee's dispatch word resolve to? No record for this target names the table, the slot or the callee, so the one indirect transfer in the body has no identified target.

Is the dispatch word at [pointee+0x0] a class vtable, and which class and vtable is it? The record associates eight vtables with this target transitively, which does not identify the one the body reads.
What is the receiver's word at displacement 0x20? The receiver record enumerates the displacement and nothing about the member: not whether it is owned, borrowed or a smart handle, and not its type.
Why is the word cleared before the slot runs rather than after? The ordering is observable in the listing, but its purpose (re-entrancy guard, ownership transfer to the callee) is not established.
What contract does 0x005bf0e0 implement? It is a shared two-pointer helper that itself dispatches to a service slot at displacement 0x2c, but this body does not identify the service it reaches.
Does the slot's return value or side effect matter to this body? EAX is overwritten by the direct call at 0x00641e30, so the body itself discards whatever the slot leaves there.
Is 0x00641e10 the only implementation of this shape, or an override of a shared base helper? No RTTI and no vtable pass exist for this binary, and the record's association is transitive.

The machine-derived receiver record is bounds_only and enumerates 0x20 and nothing else, so it states where the body was seen reaching and is not an enumeration of the receiver's words: it corroborates the 0x20 displacement and cannot refute any other receiver word. Displacement 0x4 is formed at 0x00641e2c but never dereferenced, so its absence from the record is consistent with a dereference-based observation rather than a disagreement -- but the record's own observation criteria are not documented, so it is not established here that a bounds_only record would have listed it.

conditions: The original process is driven to a Sporepedia state where the receiver's word at 0x20 is non-null.
The pointer stored at that word is captured so the dispatch word it carries, and the slot at displacement 4, can be identified in a trace.
A trace records the order of the clear at 0x00641e1e, the indirect transfer at 0x00641e29 and the direct call at 0x00641e30.
The return word left in EAX by 0x005bf0e0 is compared against the reconstructed signature.
